This patch added interface to load a program with the following
additional information:
. prog_btf_fd
. func_info
where func_info will provide function range and type_id
corresponding to each function.
The func_info_rec_size is introduced in the UAPI to specify
struct bpf_func_info size passed from user space. This
intends to make bpf_func_info structure growable in the future.
If the kernel gets a different bpf_func_info size from userspace
it will try to handle user request with part of bpf_func_info
it can understand. In this patch
struct bpf_func_info {
__u32   insn_offset;
__u32   type_id;
If user passed a bpf func_info record size of 16 bytes
kernel can still handle part of records with the above definition.
If verifier agrees with function range provided by the user
the bpf_prog ksym for each function will use the func name
provided in the type_id
column2: which is supposed to provide better

column1: encoding as it is not limited by 16 bytes program name
limitation and this is better for bpf program which contains
multiple subprograms.
The bpf_prog_info interface is also extended to
return btf_id
to userspace
column2: so userspace can print out the function prototype

column1: for each xlated function. The insn_offset in the returned
func_info corresponds to the insn offset for xlated functions.
With other jit related fields in bpf_prog_info
print out function prototypes for each jited function.
